sources.title: GSI seamless orthophoto tiles
sources.credit: 国土地理院 / Geospatial Information Authority of Japan
sources.use: Longitudinal road arrangement, exposed south conventional portal chainage. Local mosaic z18 origin x232844 y103223, 6 x 7 tiles. Pixel reference points are retained in build_v14.json.
sources.registration: Existing relayout/georef.py two-dome anchor; subtract 512,768 from its pixel coordinates. Approximately 0.48509 m/pixel; inherited model/photo scale difference remains.
sources.limitations: Seamless imagery acquisition dates vary; aerial parallax and model fit make portal estimates approximate. +/-3 m is an interpretation tolerance, not measured survey accuracy. Thin mast footings cannot all be identified.

sources.title: Hato Bus official route to Tokyo Marunouchi south boarding point
sources.use: Brick arch frontage, recessed ticket windows, yellow fascia/awning, queue rails, paving and adjacent utility louvres. Official text places the office under the railway.
sources.limitations: No dimensional drawing. Eight bays, internal service rooms, detailed utilities, street furniture and coach geometry are interpreted to fit this diorama.

sources.title: Tokyo Station overhead 2020-10-25
sources.use: Independent, staggered conventional overhead-line structures in the south throat; support and roof relationships.
sources.limitations: Oblique photo used for structural comparison, not exact mast-base coordinate extraction.

sources.title: Tokyo station Marunouchi architecture, January 2022 photographs
sources.use: Visual cross-check of south station wing context.
